result.description:
## Technical Writer

## Position Overview

We are looking for a skilled and detail-oriented Technical Writer to join our team and produce clear, accurate, and user-friendly documentation that supports both internal operations and end-user understanding. This role is central to bridging the gap between complex technical concepts and accessible written content across a range of formats and platforms. The ideal candidate will bring strong research capabilities, excellent written communication skills, and the ability to collaborate effectively with subject matter experts, developers, and stakeholders. A background in a technical discipline combined with a passion for clear communication would make you an exceptional fit for this position.

## Key Responsibilities

- Research, develop, and maintain a broad range of technical documentation including user manuals, handbooks, training materials, standard operating procedures, and multimedia content

- Translate complex technical information into clear, concise, and accurate content tailored to the intended audience, whether end users, internal teams, or stakeholders

- Collaborate closely with engineers, developers, product managers, and subject matter experts to gather information and verify technical accuracy across all documentation

- Plan, organise, and manage documentation projects from initial brief through to final publication, ensuring deadlines and quality standards are consistently met

- Review and edit existing documentation to identify gaps, inconsistencies, or outdated content, and update materials to reflect product or process changes

- Develop and apply style guides, templates, and documentation standards to ensure consistency in tone, format, and terminology across all written outputs

- Produce content for digital and print formats including online help systems, knowledge bases, e-learning modules, and technical reference guides

- Liaise with stakeholders to understand documentation requirements and translate business or technical briefs into structured, reader-focused content

- Conduct quality assurance reviews of documentation prior to release, checking for technical accuracy, readability, grammar, and adherence to brand and style guidelines

- Support the development of training materials and contribute to onboarding programmes by producing clear instructional content for new users or staff

- Manage version control and document repositories, ensuring all materials are correctly filed, versioned, and accessible to relevant teams

## Required Qualifications & Skills

- Bachelor's degree in English, Communications, Technical Writing, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline

- Demonstrated experience in a technical writing role, ideally within a corporate, technology, or engineering environment

- Exceptional written and verbal communication skills with a high level of attention to detail and accuracy

- Proven ability to research, interpret, and document complex technical subjects in a clear and accessible manner

- Proficiency in documentation tools such as MadCap Flare, Confluence, Microsoft Word, or equivalent platforms

- Experience working with content management systems, version control tools, and document repositories

- Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously and meet tight deadlines

- Ability to work collaboratively across cross-functional teams and build effective relationships with technical and non-technical stakeholders

- Sound understanding of documentation best practices, including the use of style guides such as the Microsoft Manual of Style or equivalent

## Preferred Qualifications

- Postgraduate qualification or professional certification in Technical Communication, such as a Certificate IV in Professional Writing and Editing or equivalent

- Experience with API documentation, software development lifecycle (SDLC), or working within Agile project environments

- Familiarity with graphic design or multimedia tools such as Adobe Illustrator, Snagit, or Camtasia to support visual documentation

- Exposure to single-sourcing methodologies and structured authoring frameworks such as DITA

- Prior experience in a regulated industry such as healthcare, finance, or engineering where documentation compliance is essential

## Why Join Us?

- Flexible working arrangements including hybrid and remote options to support a healthy work-life balance

- A collaborative, inclusive team culture that values expertise, continuous learning, and professional growth

- Access to ongoing training, professional development programmes, and support for further education or industry certifications

- Meaningful work that directly contributes to product quality, customer experience, and organisational knowledge

- Competitive remuneration package with additional benefits reviewed annually in line with performance

## Job Details

- Job Type: Full-time, Permanent

- Work Schedule: 8-hour shift

- Salary: $70,000 – $120,000 per year + Super

result.description:
Australian Fishing Enterprises (AFE) is the largest exporter of Southern Bluefin Tuna in Australia. Our tuna is exported around the world for sale in international marketplaces as a premium sushi/ sashimi product. We specialise in the fishing, ranching and grow out of Southern Bluefin Tuna and control the entire process from catching, feeding, harvesting, processing and delivery. 

JOB SUMMARY:
The Vessel Master will carry out duties as directed by the General Manager or Farm Managers.

Approximate start date: December 2026 & January 2027, AFE will be taking successful candidates throughout 2026/27 for these positions. Employment may be up to 4 years.

Renumeration:
The position is a Award Hourly Rate or Salary, paid on a fortnightly basis.
Vessel work completed inshore and onshore will be calculated at the nominated Farm rate.
(https://www.fairwork.gov.au/employment-conditions/awards/awards-summary/ma000114-summary)(https://awards.fairwork.gov.au/MA000114.html)
An additional contract is put in place to cover the periods offshore for Tow & Support (if applicable).


Operations:
Periods at sea are varied and weather dependent. Hours of operation are determined by the daily operational needs. Farm vessels can be required to conduct operations year round from land based sites out to the farming site. The season begins in December finishing with the annual harvest period throughout June, July & August.
January – July Operations are 7 days per week; you can work up to 6 days in a week. Up to 12 hours per day.
August to December Operations are 5 days per week Monday to Friday, you will work up to 5 days in a week, 8 hours per day.

Vessel Master Duties:
The Employee will be required to perform certain duties whilst Master of the Vessel. Although this list is not exhaustive, it is a generalised overview of duties.
•	Ensure crew work in such a way, to minimize risks to their health, safety, and others.
•	Being involved in and overseeing the induction and ongoing training of crew and ensure safe work practices are continually developed and maintained. Ensure that all training is recorded on communication forms and passed on to the Farm Manager.
•	Ensuring that only employees and approved maintenance contractors come onboard or attend any work sites. 
•	Documenting bait received, fed out, uneaten feed and daily fish behaviour. 
•	Report daily to the Farm Manager.
•	Directing and training crew on feeding in accordance with daily feed plans and correct feeding techniques.
•	Working the vessel within the regulations and relevant fisheries management rules. Ensuring that you are familiar with restricted areas regarding other farming operations, fisheries licensing conditions, national parks and within the bounds of safe and good seamanship. 
•	Keeping the vessel clean, tidy, and safe with safety and spare equipment accessible and organized.
•	Ensuring the engine room is operating properly.  The skipper is ultimately responsible for the whole vessel.
•	Routinely checking all is in order and secure and dry in the chain locker, void spaces, bilge, steering compartment etc. (This is just basic seamanship and neglecting this responsibility is not acceptable).
•	Routinely checking lifting gear is in a safe state (blocks, wire, ropes, shackles, hoses).
•	Ensuring vessel is berthed properly and manned sufficiently, not leaving inexperienced deckhands to be responsible for securing the vessel. 
•	Ensuring all necessary gear, oils, jobs etc. are ordered and performed in a timely manner
•	Carry out farm maintenance and repairs as required by The Farm Manager.
•	Assisting in transfer of tuna to farms
•	Assisting in general tuna farm duties including feeding, harvesting, processing and maintenance.
•	Ensuring own qualifications are kept up to date.
•	Maintaining Ship’s Log daily as per statutory requirements and farm requirements. Entries should include date, position, weather, personnel on board, departure times, names of current crew at the commencement of each trip, fuel/water/oil taken on and any other relevant information should be properly recorded to be able to refer to it later.

MASTERS’s SAFETY RESPONSIBILITIES
•	Ensure that health and safety are taken into account when new or changed methods, processes, products, harmful substances are implemented
•	Provide proper instructions and training in health and safety for new Crew and for Crew redeployed into new jobs.
•	Take the necessary precautions, (so far as reasonably practical,) to protect contractors and members of the public whilst on company vessels & premises.
•	Ensure all accidents reported are fully investigated and the appropriate corrective action has been taken. Set the example for compliance with the safety policy and maintain a continued involvement, interest and enthusiasm in the health and safety programme.
•	Ensure the necessary checklists are in use to help provide a safe work environment at all work sites and that the required frequency of checking is maintained.

Perform maintenance, repairs, and reconditioning works on all types of earthmoving, Heavy Diesel, Plant & Equipment machinery and Engines at various locations and sites.

Well-developed communication and customer service skills
The ability to work autonomously and as a team as required
Demonstrated and proven ability with desktop computers and devices
Experience on various Diagnostic Systems

Your ability to work under pressure during peak periods is essential

Only successful applicants will be notified.

result.description:
Waroona, Full Time, Marketing
Vacancy Listing Dates 9/07/2026 to 6/08/2026
Please Quote Reference Number 17523
- Skilled Marketing Manager / Advertising Specialist wanted
- Mon - Fri (38 hours a week)
- Join the friendly team at Drakesbrook Hotel Motel in Waroona

About Drakesbrook Hotel Motel

Drakesbrook Hotel Motel is a well-established hospitality venue located in Waroona, Western Australia. The business offers accommodation, dining, bar facilities, events and entertainment to locals and visitors alike. With a strong focus on exceptional customer experiences and continued business growth together with a Development plan for extra rooms and a caravan park, The Drakesbrook Hotel is investing in strategic marketing initiatives to strengthen brand awareness, increase patronage, grow accommodation bookings and maximise revenue across all areas of the business.

The Marketing Manager / Advertising Specialist will play a key role in developing and implementing advertising and marketing strategies that support these commercial objectives.

About the Candidate

The successful applicant will be a highly organised and commercially minded marketing professional with a passion for delivering measurable business results through advertising and digital marketing.

They will possess strong analytical skills, creativity, excellent communication abilities and the confidence to manage multiple projects simultaneously while working collaboratively with internal stakeholders and external suppliers.

The successful candidate will be proactive, adaptable and capable of identifying new opportunities to increase customer acquisition, engagement and revenue.

Essential Requirements:
- Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Advertising, Communications or related discipline.
- Minimum 7 years’ experience in advertising, digital marketing or marketing strategy.
- Demonstrated experience developing and executing integrated advertising campaigns.
- Strong understanding of digital advertising platforms including Google Ads and Meta Ads Manager.
- Experience analysing campaign performance using Google Analytics or equivalent reporting tools.
- Experience managing advertising budgets and optimising campaign performance.
- Strong written communication and copywriting skills.
- Excellent organisational and project management abilities.
- Ability to interpret marketing data and provide strategic recommendations.
- Experience working with multiple stakeholders and external suppliers.

Desirable:
- Experience within hospitality, tourism, accommodation or food & beverage industries.
- Experience with email marketing platforms.
- Basic understanding of SEO principles.
- Experience managing social media content calendars.

Key Responsibilities
- The successful applicant will be responsible for, but not limited to:
- Develop and implement advertising and marketing strategies aligned with business objectives.
- Plan, execute and optimise digital advertising campaigns across Google, Meta and other relevant platforms.
- Monitor campaign performance and provide ongoing analysis and recommendations to maximise return on investment.
- Conduct market research and competitor analysis to identify trends and business opportunities.
- Manage marketing budgets and advertising expenditure.
- Coordinate promotional campaigns for accommodation, restaurant, bar, events and seasonal initiatives.
- Work closely with venue management to develop annual marketing plans and promotional calendars.
- Liaise with external suppliers including designers, printers, photographers and media partners.
- Prepare regular reports on campaign performance, customer engagement and marketing effectiveness.
- Ensure brand consistency across all advertising and promotional material.
- Assist in developing customer acquisition and retention strategies.
- Support event promotion through targeted advertising and integrated marketing campaigns.
- Maintain awareness of emerging marketing technologies, consumer trends and advertising best practice.

Additional Duties
- From time to time, the successful applicant may also be required to:
- Update website content including promotions, menus, accommodation packages and event information.
- Create and schedule email marketing campaigns.
- Assist with social media planning, content creation and scheduling.
- Write promotional copy for digital and print advertising.
- Undertake other marketing-related duties as reasonably required by management

A salary of $80,000 - $85,000 will be offered to the successful candidate.

Apply now through our online application form - https://www.netyourjob.com.au/jobs/17523.php
